Oiolassë, also called Say-arana, grows in the frigid regions of Endor, along freshwater banks and shores. Its cloves are almost impossible to gather because the plant is exceptionally rare.

Among Elves, ingesting a clove prevents wounds from worsening for two days and allows healing to work at full effectiveness. The entry does not specify an equivalent effect for other peoples. Repeated doses carry a significant risk of dependence.
